title: Opening hours
text: The shop opens at 9:00 on weekdays and 10:00 on Saturdays. It is closed on Sundays and on public holidays.

title: Returns
text: Customers may return unused parts within 30 days with a receipt. Opened tyres and inner tubes cannot be returned.

title: Puncture repair
text: A puncture repair takes about 20 minutes and costs 8 euros. The mechanic checks the tyre for glass before fitting the new tube.

title: Standard service
text: A standard service includes brake adjustment, gear tuning and a chain check. Book it at least two days ahead.

title: Frame warranty
text: Frames carry a five-year warranty against manufacturing faults. Wear parts such as brake pads and chains are not covered.

title: Helmet fitting
text: Every child bike sold includes a free helmet fitting. Staff adjust the straps until two fingers fit under the chin.

title: Deliveries
text: Orders over 100 euros ship free within the country. Delivery takes three to five working days.

title: Staff training
text: New staff shadow a mechanic for two weeks before working alone. Every mechanic completes a first-aid course each year.

title: Workshop cleaning
text: The workshop floor is swept at closing time. Used oil goes into the sealed blue drum and is collected monthly.

title: Test rides
text: Test rides last up to 15 minutes and need a photo ID left at the counter. E-bikes require a signed waiver.

title: Loyalty points
text: Members collect one point per euro and receive a 5 euro voucher for every 500 points.

title: Winter storage
text: Customers can store a bike over winter for 25 euros per month. Stored bikes get a free brake check in spring.
